aka.zh: 比亚埃尔莫萨—埃斯卡塞加—切图马尔公路

tagline.en: From Villahermosa across the base of the Yucatán peninsula and the Calakmul forest to Chetumal, the road that first joined Quintana Roo's capital to the rest of Mexico
tagline.zh: 从比亚埃尔莫萨横穿尤卡坦半岛根部和卡拉克穆尔森林抵达切图马尔，正是这条路第一次把金塔纳罗奥的首府与墨西哥其他地方连起来

start.zh: 塔巴斯科州首府比亚埃尔莫萨

end.en: Chetumal, capital of Quintana Roo, on the bay facing Belize; a branch runs to the border crossing at Subteniente López
end.zh: 金塔纳罗奥州首府切图马尔，濒临与伯利兹相望的海湾；一条支线通往苏布特尼恩特洛佩斯边境口岸

en: Federal Highway 186 runs east from Villahermosa through the wetlands of Tabasco by Macuspana, touches Chiapas at Catazajá, crosses back into Tabasco at Emiliano Zapata and enters Campeche to reach Francisco Escárcega. From Escárcega it runs straight east for 277 km through the forest of southern Campeche by Xpujil, near the Maya sites of Calakmul, to Chetumal.

English and Spanish Wikipedia, from the ministry's 2011 traffic tables, give 574.4 km. It is the main land route into Quintana Roo from the rest of the country. Traffic is light in the forest: in the ministry's counts for 2016 the road carried 3,406 vehicles a day at Escárcega, 2,688 at Xpujil and 7,324 approaching Chetumal.
zh: 186 号联邦公路自比亚埃尔莫萨向东，经马库斯帕纳穿过塔巴斯科的湿地，在卡塔萨哈短暂进入恰帕斯州，在埃米利亚诺萨帕塔重回塔巴斯科，再进入坎佩切州抵达弗朗西斯科埃斯卡塞加。从埃斯卡塞加起，公路一路向东 277 公里，穿过坎佩切南部的森林，经靠近卡拉克穆尔玛雅遗址的斯普希尔，抵达切图马尔。
英文和西班牙文维基百科依据交通部 2011 年交通数据表，给出 574.4 公里。它是从墨西哥其他地方进入金塔纳罗奥的主要陆路。森林路段车流稀少：交通部 2016 年的观测显示，埃斯卡塞加日均 3,406 辆，斯普希尔 2,688 辆，切图马尔近郊 7,324 辆。

en: When Javier Rojo Gómez became governor of the federal territory of Quintana Roo in May 1967, there was not a single paved road in it, and Chetumal was the only capital in Mexico still reached by a dirt road. The nearest point was Escárcega, and the way there was a loggers' track that took between twelve hours and two days depending on the rain, as the historian Francisco Bautista recalls in a history published by the Quintana Roo government. Rojo Gómez went to President Gustavo Díaz Ordaz for money; by that account the president asked why a place with no people needed roads, and Rojo Gómez answered that there would never be people without them.

The Chetumal–Escárcega road was inaugurated in 1970, the first paved road in Quintana Roo, a few months after work on Cancún began. A historical marker in Chetumal records that the roads to Escárcega and Mérida were both opened before Rojo Gómez's term ended; he died in office at the end of 1970. In the 1970s the government settled colonists along the new road in southern Campeche.
zh: 1967 年 5 月哈维尔·罗霍·戈麦斯出任金塔纳罗奥联邦属地长官时，属地内连一条铺装公路也没有，切图马尔是墨西哥唯一仍只能经土路到达的首府。最近的外界据点是埃斯卡塞加，去那里只有一条伐木便道，视雨情需走十二小时到两天，金塔纳罗奥州政府出版的一部史书中，史家弗朗西斯科·包蒂斯塔如此回忆。罗霍·戈麦斯去找古斯塔沃·迪亚斯·奥尔达斯总统要钱；据该书记述，总统问一个没有人口的地方要公路做什么，罗霍·戈麦斯答道，没有公路就永远不会有人口。
切图马尔—埃斯卡塞加公路于 1970 年落成，是金塔纳罗奥第一条铺装公路，比坎昆开工晚几个月。切图马尔的一块历史标牌记载，通往埃斯卡塞加和梅里达的公路都在罗霍·戈麦斯任期结束前通车；他于 1970 年底在任上去世。1970 年代，政府沿这条新路在坎佩切南部安置垦殖移民。

en: No cost has been found for the original road; the history published by the Quintana Roo government says only that funds flowed once the president had agreed. The modern work is federal. President Felipe Calderón inaugurated the modernisation of the Villahermosa–Escárcega section on 26 October 2012: 220.3 km, from kilometre 46.7 to 267, widened from 7 to 12 metres, for 3,812.9 million pesos. The new Chablé bridge on that section, 345.97 m long, was reported at 136.87 million pesos.
zh: 未找到原有公路的造价；金塔纳罗奥州政府出版的那部史书只说总统点头后资金便源源而来。现代的工程属联邦项目。2012 年 10 月 26 日，费利佩·卡尔德龙总统为比亚埃尔莫萨—埃斯卡塞加段改造工程剪彩：220.3 公里，自 46.7 公里处至 267 公里处，由 7 米拓宽至 12 米，耗资 38.129 亿比索。该段新建的查布莱大桥长 345.97 米，据报道造价 1.3687 亿比索。

figures.source: SCT, Datos Viales 2011, as cited in English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 186, and Spanish Wikipedia, Carretera Federal 186

why.en: No source found gives a cost for the road built in the late 1960s; the only cost found is for the 2012 modernisation of Villahermosa–Escárcega, given below.
why.zh: 所查资料均未给出 1960 年代末所修公路的造价；所见造价只涉及 2012 年比亚埃尔莫萨—埃斯卡塞加段的改造，见下。

value.en: The federal government: President Díaz Ordaz authorised the money for the Chetumal–Escárcega road at the request of the territorial governor, Javier Rojo Gómez
value.zh: 联邦政府：迪亚斯·奥尔达斯总统应属地长官哈维尔·罗霍·戈麦斯的请求，批准了切图马尔—埃斯卡塞加公路的资金

figures.source: Fernando Martí, “Un aliado invaluable”, Fantasía de Banqueros II, published by the Coordinación General de Comunicación, Gobierno de Quintana Roo

label.zh: 比亚埃尔莫萨—埃斯卡塞加段改造

value.en: 220.3 km widened from 7 to 12 m; 3,812.9 million pesos; inaugurated 26 October 2012

figures.source: TyT (Transportes y Turismo), on the inauguration, 2012

value.en: 345.97 m long. Cost reported at 136.87 million pesos by a trade site covering the 2012 modernisation; not checked against SCT accounts
value.zh: 长 345.97 米。据一家报道 2012 年改造工程的行业网站，造价 1.3687 亿比索；未与交通部账目核对

figures.source: Alianza Flotillera, on the Villahermosa–Escárcega modernisation

value.en: 3,406 vehicles a day at Escárcega; 2,688 at Xpujil; 7,324 near Chetumal
value.zh: 埃斯卡塞加日均 3,406 辆；斯普希尔 2,688 辆；切图马尔附近 7,324 辆

timeline.en: Javier Rojo Gómez becomes governor of Quintana Roo in May; there is no paved road in the territory.
timeline.zh: 5 月，哈维尔·罗霍·戈麦斯出任金塔纳罗奥属地长官；当时属地内没有一条铺装公路。

timeline.en: The paved road from Felipe Carrillo Puerto towards Mérida opens in December.
timeline.zh: 12 月，自费利佩卡里略港通往梅里达的铺装公路通车。

timeline.en: The Chetumal–Escárcega road is inaugurated, the first paved road in Quintana Roo; Rojo Gómez dies at the end of the year.
timeline.zh: 切图马尔—埃斯卡塞加公路落成，成为金塔纳罗奥第一条铺装公路；罗霍·戈麦斯于年底去世。

timeline.en: President Calderón inaugurates the widened Villahermosa–Escárcega section on 26 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 26 日，卡尔德龙总统为拓宽后的比亚埃尔莫萨—埃斯卡塞加段剪彩。

timeline.en: Ministry counts show 2,688 vehicles a day at Xpujil, in the middle of the forest section.
timeline.zh: 交通部观测显示，森林路段中部的斯普希尔日均 2,688 辆。
